data.standardized_narrative: Unable to locate a clear, extractable gross prior-year claims movement or opening gross claims outstanding in the supplied images. The report images provided are rotated and low resolution which prevented reliable extraction of the balance sheet 'Claims outstanding' prior-year (2018) gross figure and the movement-in-prior-years reconciliation note. Gross written premium was readable on the segmental/premium table, but reserves and prior-year movement figures could not be identified with confidence.
data.data_quality_notes: Document pages supplied as rotated, low-resolution images. I could not confidently locate the Balance Sheet line 'Claims outstanding' in the LIABILITIES (technical provisions) or a 'Movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding' gross column. The gross premiums total (247,444 in the report currency $000) was readable on the premiums table (page ~26) and converted to millions (247.444). All reserve-related numeric fields returned as null due to inability to identify an unambiguous GROSS claims outstanding prior-year figure or a gross prior-year movement in the available images. Recommend supplying higher-resolution, correctly-oriented PDF pages for the Balance Sheet (liabilities / technical provisions) and the Technical Reserves movement note to extract prior-year development and opening gross claims outstanding.
